rationale: Executive Order 9941 was superseded as a whole by section 2 of Executive Order 10897 (signed 1960-12-02, effective as of 1960-10-16 under its section 3), whose Federal Register text is held. The two history observations, the Office of the Federal Register note 'Superseded by: EO 10897, December 2, 1960' and the 1989 codification row 'Superseded by EO 10897', agree with the held text. The order was a single delegation with no earlier end and no surviving independent command, so it was not in force on 2026-10-14.
